items.text: Buffalo (TBD): WR DJ Moore (knee/AC joint), WR Joshua Palmer (hamstring), RT Spencer Brown (back). S C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended; WR Tyrell Shavers (ACL, PUP).

Minnesota: QB Kyler Murray has hamstring soreness; Kevin O'Connell said 'I don't think we're there yet' on whether it affects Monday's game - monitor. TBD: LT Christian Darrisaw (shoulder), S Theo Jackson (quad). G Donovan Jackson (meniscus) out for the regular season; TE Josh Oliver (season), C Nick Samac on IR.
